_note: Style presets, ported from the old tool's niche_styles.json.
niche     - subject matter and tone (WW2 History, True Crime, Relationship Advice)
art_style - how the picture is rendered (Studio Ghibli Style, Pixar 3D, Chibi Cute)
style - the STYLE: line in the agent prompt (story_to_agent_prompt.js)
whisk - wording for character-sheet / image prompts, used by hand in Whisk
The rest - palette, camera, audience - are authoring notes for a human. No tool
`label` MAY NAME A REAL STUDIO. `style` and `whisk` MUST NOT.
The label is a menu entry; the other two are typed into a prompt. Naming a real
studio or brand is a distinctive protected house style, and Google's models
often refuse or quietly sanitise such prompts. The Bridge story had to be
rewritten to remove 27 mentions of one studio name for exactly this reason, so
the presets describe the look instead. Label 'Studio Ghibli Style' is how you
find the entry; its `style` says 'hand-painted 2D animation, soft watercolour
backgrounds' and never uses the word. Swap a label's wording into `style`
yourself if you would rather name the studio and take the risk.
